views.name: repo_basic
views.body_sql: SELECT "repo_name" AS repo_name, "watch_count" AS watch_count FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_REPOS
views.description: One-row-per-repository projection exposing primary repo attributes useful as a starting cohort for repo-level filters and joins (e.g., restrict to repos with non-null watch_count or feed into aggregations). | Use for: List repos and their watch_count; Filter repos by watch_count thresholds (downstream WHERE); Join repo-level attributes onto file/commit lists

views.name: file_listing
views.body_sql: SELECT "repo_name" AS repo_name, "ref" AS ref, "path" AS path, "mode" AS mode, "id" AS id, "symlink_target" AS symlink_target FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_FILES
grain: one row per file entry (repo_name, ref, path, id)
views.description: One-row-per-file-entry projection from SAMPLE_FILES exposing file identity and location within a repo/ref; useful for file-level cohorts and joins to contents or repos. | Use for: List files for a repo and ref; Filter files by path patterns or symlink status; Join to SAMPLE_CONTENTS to get content metadata

views.name: content_master
views.body_sql: SELECT "id" AS id, "size" AS size, "content" AS content, "binary" AS binary, "copies" AS copies, "sample_repo_name" AS sample_repo_name, "sample_ref" AS sample_ref, "sample_path" AS sample_path, "sample_mode" AS sample_mode, "sample_symlink_target" AS sample_symlink_target FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS
views.description: One-row-per-content-id projection exposing content metadata (size, binary flag, copies) and a sampled example location. Use when analyzing uniqueness of blobs or joining to file listings. | Use for: Find largest/smallest content blobs; Identify binary vs text blobs; Count how many files share the same content id (compare copies)

views.name: repo_languages_exploded
views.body_sql: SELECT "repo_name" AS repo_name, l.value AS language_value, l.index AS language_index FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.LANGUAGES, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "language") l
grain: one row per (repo_name, exploded language element)
views.description: Normalized view of languages per repo. EXPLODES the VARIANT 'language' column if it is an array/object; if language is scalar it will appear as language_value. Preserves repo_name for joins. | Use for: Count repos by language; Filter repos that mention a particular language token; Join language tokens to repo-level metrics

views.name: repo_license_list
views.body_sql: SELECT "repo_name" AS repo_name, "license" AS license FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.LICENSES
views.description: Normalized one-row-per (repo, license) projection. Useful to join license text/value onto repos and to count license distribution. | Use for: Distribution of licenses across sampled repos; Filter repos by license type

views.name: files_with_content
views.body_sql: SELECT f.repo_name AS repo_name, f.ref AS ref, f.path AS path, f.mode AS mode, f.id AS id, f.symlink_target AS symlink_target, c.size AS size, c.content AS content, c.binary AS binary, c.copies AS copies, c.sample_repo_name AS sample_repo_name, c.sample_ref AS sample_ref, c.sample_path AS sample_path FROM (SELECT "repo_name" AS repo_name, "ref" AS ref, "path" AS path, "mode" AS mode, "id" AS id, "symlink_target" AS symlink_target FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_FILES) f LEFT JOIN (SELECT "id" AS id, "size" AS size, "content" AS content, "binary" AS binary, "copies" AS copies, "sample_repo_name" AS sample_repo_name, "sample_ref" AS sample_ref, "sample_path" AS sample_path, "sample_mode" AS sample_mode, "sample_symlink_target" AS sample_symlink_target FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS) c ON f.id = c.id
grain: one row per file entry (repo_name, ref, path, id) with content metadata
views.description: Denormalized file-level relation joining SAMPLE_FILES to SAMPLE_CONTENTS on content id. Preserves file identity and content metadata. Note: join may multiply content rows when content shared across many files (copies). | Use for: Find files with largest content; Identify files that reference a shared blob; Filter file listings by whether content is binary

views.name: repo_commit_basic
views.body_sql: SELECT "commit" AS commit, "tree" AS tree, "parent" AS parent, "author" AS author, "committer" AS committer, "subject" AS subject, "message" AS message, "repo_name" AS repo_name, "encoding" AS encoding FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_COMMITS
views.description: One-row-per-sampled-commit exposing commit id, repo association, subject and message plus raw author/committer VARIANTs. Useful as the base for commit text search or extracting author dates from the VARIANT. | Use for: Search commit messages for keywords; Join commits to repos to report commit counts per repo; Extract author/committer metadata from VARIANT

views.name: top_contents_by_size_ranked
views.body_sql:
SELECT "id" AS id,
       "size" AS size,
       "copies" AS copies,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "size" DESC NULLS LAST, "id") AS size_rank
FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS
grain: one row per content id with global size rank
views.description: Ranks content ids by size descending and exposes a size_rank column. Useful for downstream top-K selection using WHERE size_rank <= K (do not hardcode K here). | Use for: Select top-N largest content blobs (WHERE size_rank <= N); Analyze distribution of large blobs across repos (join to files)

views.name: repo_file_counts
views.body_sql: SELECT f.repo_name AS repo_name, f.ref AS ref, COUNT(*) AS total_files, SUM(CASE WHEN c.binary = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_binary_files, SUM(c.size) AS total_bytes FROM (SELECT "repo_name" AS repo_name, "ref" AS ref, "id" AS id FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_FILES) f LEFT JOIN (SELECT "id" AS id, "size" AS size, "binary" AS binary FROM GITHUB_REPOS.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_CONTENTS) c ON f.id = c.id GROUP BY f.repo_name, f.ref
views.description: Aggregate counts and totals of files per repo and ref: total_files, total_binary_files (by joining content binary flag when available), total_bytes. Useful for repo-level file statistics. | Use for: Compare file counts and bytes across refs or repos; Identify repos/ref snapshots with many binary files
